# sitecoreedge_tenant (Data Source)

Gets the tenant ID for Sitecore Edge

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sitecoreedge_tenant" "current" {}

output "tenant_id" {
  value = data.sitecoreedge_tenant.current.tenant_id
}

output "media_url" {
  value = "https://edge.sitecorecloud.io/${data.sitecoreedge_tenant.current.tenant_id}/media/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Dummy ID for the datasource
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant ID
